ask: How investor-ready am I, and what should I improve first?
reply:
Q: You’re not investor-ready for marketplace discovery yet. The first thing to improve is visibility: choose to make Kiln Payroll’s profile visible to investors. After that, complete founder identity verification and organisation verification. Those gaps may not block discovery, but they will limit investor confidence once people can see you. I’d prioritise visibility and verification first, then finish the financial and commercial evidence investors will test.
